description:
Configuration for the boltdocs doctor command.
This schema defines the structure of doctor.json.

$schema.description: Path to the JSON schema for validation and autocompletion.

checks.description: Configuration for specific documentation health checks.

metadata.description: Metadata and SEO related checks (title, description, frontmatter).

titleMin.description: Minimum character length for page titles.

titleMax.description: Maximum character length for page titles.

descriptionMin.description: Minimum character length for page descriptions.

required.description: List of frontmatter fields that MUST be present.

optional.description: List of optional frontmatter fields that are allowed.

validateDates.description: Whether to validate date formats in frontmatter.

internal.description: Whether to check internal documentation links.

external.description: Whether to check external website links.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for external link checks.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of parallel external link requests.

ignore.description: List of URL patterns to ignore during link checking.

fix.description: Automated fix behavior and safety settings.

confirmChanges.description: Ask for confirmation before applying each automated fix.

backupFiles.description: Create a backup copy of files before modifying them.

backupPath.description: Directory path where backups will be stored.

reporting.description: Configuration for diagnostic reports and CI/CD exit behavior.

outputFile.description: Optional file path to save the diagnostic report (JSON).

failOnError.description: Exit with a non-zero code if critical errors are found (for CI).

maxWarnings.description: Maximum number of allowed warnings before exiting with error. Use -1 for no limit.

severity.description:
Severity overrides for different types of issues.
Can be 'high', 'warning', 'low', or 'off'.

exclude.description: List of glob patterns to exclude from analysis.
